summary: Tactical air navigation beacon at Marham, channel 24X, may cause aircrew to lose distance measuring equipment overhead and experience azimuth swings between 180 and 195 degrees.
text:
TACAN MAM/MARHAM 108.7MHZ CH24X AIRCREW MAY EXPERIENCE LOSS OF 
DME IN THE OVERHEAD AND MAY EXPERIENCE AZIMUTH SWINGS BTN 180 AND 
195 DEGREES
